name: Du Hang pagoda
kicker: Phúc Lâm pagoda in Hồ Nam
summary: Walk the pagoda the city page calls Phúc Lâm tự, in what that page writes as xã Dư Hàng Kênh, now phường Hồ Nam, quận Lê Chân. It gives a seven-bay Buddha hall and a three-storey bell tower. The bell is inscribed Phúc Lâm tự chung. A fee and a gate hour are Check on arrival. This is not đình Hàng Kênh.
getThere: Hồ Nam, Lê Chân. Minutes from the opera are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The pagoda front, with Phúc Lâm tự on the beam

notice.title: Not đình Hàng Kênh
notice.body: The communal house with the boat floor and the dragon carving is Hàng Kênh. This pagoda is Phúc Lâm.

body: The city page ties a stele to the early Lê, 980–1009, and the Trúc Lâm line to Trần Nhân Tông. Memorial days on that page are the 2nd of lunar month 11 for Trần Nhân Tông and the 3rd for Huyền Quang. It was ranked a historic relic in 1986. The 1926 memorial for Phan Chu Trinh happened here. That is history on the page, not a current festival.
The front carries the name on the beam. The visit the page describes is the seven-bay hall and the three-storey bell tower. A distance from the opera, a fee, and a gate hour are Check on arrival.

figures.caption: The thousand-armed figure inside Dư Hàng pagoda
figures.alt: A thousand-armed figure seated in the hall at Du Hang pagoda, with fruit and flowers

gettingThere: The pagoda page places it in phường Hồ Nam, quận Lê Chân. It does not print a distance from the opera square. The minutes are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the opera square
legs.body: The center is the base if you sleep there. The pagoda page does not print the minutes. Check on arrival.

closed: A weekly closing day was not printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: No fee was printed on the pagoda page. Check on arrival.
